A body built to that shape from the moved findings (deployed_path_cases, CONSTRUCTED, not a door run) RETURNED at both commits and the ticket path shows the server words. Which body the live door serves is NOT measured (no live call). The four new codes are shown as the server's description with a 'Row N:' prefix at both commits; SHEETS_NOT_READ is shown by no reader. PROD and DEV differ in the ticket message for a raw reason code (PROD shows TEMPLATE_FINDINGS in the words; DEV shows 'the file needs a correction.').
